result.statement: No falsifier for PF-VIS-005 was found on the inspected Project-Frankenstein history surface. Commit-history searches exposed the adaptive detector/VLM routing lineage, FrankEye, and native_vision migrations; 'familiar' hits concerned spatial-room familiarity rather than image identity learning. Direct inspection of the original Stage-1 visual pipeline showed stateless YOLO object detection, Tesseract OCR, scene/screenshot/photo/diagram heuristics and color extraction, with no persistent personal visual classifier/prototype learner.

source_refs.meaning: Introduces Adaptive Visual Pipeline: YOLO+OCR Stage 1 plus optional VLM Stage 2
Stage-1 source inspected for learning/persistence state
Returned vision architecture lineage commits including 9059666, 0fd27f23, 4def0bb4, 279eb175 and 6158be8d
Returned spatial room-familiarity history, not visual identity learning

anti_overclaim_boundary: This is not proof of repository-wide absence. Commit-message search is incomplete evidence and the frozen Project-Frankenstein tree/history denominator remains unfrozen. The result only strengthens the negative conclusion for the directly inspected visual lineage.
architecture_delta: No change to the preceding receipt: current Clay 0.1 work must keep native semantic perception separate from an explicit user-specific adaptive visual learner unless later exhaustive history produces a genuine inherited learner.
next_falsifier: Inspect Drive Retina source/training artifacts and any Project-Frankenstein history paths discovered once the complete tree/history denominator is available; search specifically for persistent prototype/classifier stores, trusted visual examples, user-object identity, face/person identity learning, online fit/update, open-set calibration and rollback/version state.
